title: Request (robot-domain-rules/3)
description: One question: may this participant do this action in this area, given these facts? SPEC.md § Request.

participant.description: A well-formed request always names the participant. The evaluator itself requires a non-empty id only when an approval is needed (an approval binds to the participant); a request without one is still decided when no approval is involved (SPEC.md § 6 step 6).

targetRobotId.description: 0.2 field; copied into facts.targetRobotId when absent there.

history.description: What this participant did recently, as the caller reports it. Needed only by rules with history conditions.

now.description: The instant of the request, from the caller's trusted layer. Needed for history windows and for signed approvals.

consumedApprovals.description: Nonces of approvals already acted on; such an approval does not apply (replay).

facts.description: The declared facts by ID, plus the built-in approvedBy: one approval, or a list of them (each clears at most one wait).
